氯气的制备及性质 · 3D 互动课件: Preparation and Properties of Chlorine · Interactive 3D Lesson
人教版必修第一册 第二章第二节「氯及其化合物」p.44–52: PEP Compulsory Book 1 · Chapter 2, Section 2 "Chlorine and Its Compounds" pp.44–52
要一瓶干燥、纯净的氯气，装置里每一段各管什么？少一段会怎样？: To get a bottle of dry, pure chlorine, what does each section of the apparatus do? What happens if one is missing?
浓盐酸 + MnO₂ 加热才有 Cl₂，变稀就停: Concentrated HCl + MnO₂ gives Cl₂ only when heated, and stops once the acid is dilute
饱和食盐水洗掉挥发的 HCl: Saturated brine washes out the volatile HCl
浓硫酸除水汽，湿氯气才会漂白: Concentrated sulfuric acid removes water vapor; only wet chlorine bleaches
同温下比空气重 2.486 倍，向上排空气、长进短出: 2.486 times as dense as air at the same temperature: upward air displacement, long tube in, short tube out
NaOH 吸收多余 Cl₂，漏一段就中毒: NaOH absorbs excess Cl₂; leave out this section and people get poisoned
整体 · 一条从烧瓶到烧杯的装置链: Overview · one chain of apparatus from flask to beaker
改一个开关，看整条链的后果: Change one switch and see the consequences along the whole chain
全对！装置顺序、每段作用、氯水成分你都理顺了。: All correct! You have sorted out the order of the apparatus, the job of each section and what chlorine water contains.
建议回看主线：发生 → 除杂 → 收集 → 尾气，再走一遍氯水那一步。: Review the main thread: generation → purification → collection → exhaust, then go through the chlorine water step again.
气流方向：沿装置顺序进入下一段: Gas flow: on to the next section in order
洗气瓶长进短出：进气管口低于液面: Wash bottle long in, short out: inlet below the liquid surface
集气瓶长进短出：导管伸到瓶底: Gas jar long in, short out: tube reaches the bottom
有色布条与干布条的对照: Colored cloth strip versus dry strip
浓硫酸瓶同样长进: The sulfuric acid bottle is also long in
进气导管伸到瓶底: Inlet tube reaches the bottom of the jar
尾气未接：Cl₂ 排空: Exhaust not connected: Cl₂ vents to the air
HClO 光照分解出 O₂: HClO decomposes in light, releasing O₂
圆底烧瓶 + 分液漏斗 + 酒精灯：MnO₂ 与浓盐酸共热: Round-bottom flask + dropping funnel + spirit lamp: MnO₂ heated with concentrated HCl
饱和食盐水洗 HCl、浓硫酸干燥，两段都能拆下来: Saturated brine washes out HCl and concentrated sulfuric acid dries; both sections can be removed
向上排空气法：导管伸到瓶底，瓶口短管出气: Upward air displacement: the tube reaches the bottom and gas leaves through a short tube at the mouth
NaOH 溶液吸收多余的 Cl₂，防止中毒与污染: NaOH solution absorbs excess Cl₂ to prevent poisoning and pollution
新制氯水、对照、AgNO₃ 检验与光照管，外加粒子放大: Fresh chlorine water, control, AgNO₃ test and light-exposed tube, plus a magnified particle view
一套制氯气的装置，凭什么分成这么几段？: Why is an apparatus for making chlorine divided into these sections?
拖动视角，绕着这张实验台看一圈（滚轮拉近拉远）: Drag to look all the way around the bench (scroll to zoom)
看到从左到右五段：加热的圆底烧瓶、两个洗气瓶、集气瓶、NaOH 烧杯，台面前缘还: Five sections from left to right: heated round-bottom flask, two wash bottles, gas jar and NaOH beaker, with a row of chlorine water test tubes along the front edge
发生 → 除杂（如需要）→ 收集 → 尾气（如需要）: Generation → purification (if needed) → collection → exhaust (if needed)
教材 p.49「实验室中制取气体装置的设计」: Textbook p.49 "Designing gas preparation apparatus in the lab"
发生装置看反应物的状态和反应条件：固体 MnO₂ 加液体浓盐酸，还要加热。: The generator depends on the reactants' states and conditions: solid MnO₂ plus liquid concentrated HCl, with heating.
除杂装置看杂质的性质：浓盐酸挥发出的 HCl 极易溶于水。: Purification depends on the impurity's properties: the HCl evaporating from concentrated acid is extremely soluble in water.
收集装置看密度、溶解性、是否与水反应：Cl₂ 比空气重、又溶于水。: Collection depends on density, solubility and reaction with water: Cl₂ is denser than air and dissolves in water.
去掉分段思路：只能照着图抄装置，换一种气体就不知道怎么设计了。: Without thinking in sections you can only copy the apparatus from a diagram, and will not know how to design one for another gas.
常考「制气装置由哪几部分组成、按什么顺序连」：发生 → 除杂 → 收集 → 尾气: A common question: what parts a gas preparation apparatus has and in what order: generation → purification → collection → exhaust.
教材图 2-17 的三段是「发生 → 收集 → 尾气」；p.49 方法导引允许「: The three parts in textbook Fig. 2-17 are "generation → collection → exhaust"; the method guide on p.49 allows adding purification "if needed" and gives the order: generation → purification → collection → exhaust. This lesson makes purification and drying each a removable section.
不点酒精灯，氯气还出得来吗？: Without lighting the spirit lamp, will chlorine still come out?
把「加热」打开，盯住烧瓶里的 MnO₂ 和导管里的气流: Turn "heat" on and watch the MnO₂ in the flask and the gas flow in the tube
气泡从无到有：产生速率 0.0 → 30.0 mL/min，MnO₂ 表面开始持: Bubbles appear from nothing: generation rate 0.0 → 30.0 mL/min, the MnO₂ surface bubbles steadily and gas-flow balls travel along the tube to the next section
反应物是固体 MnO₂ 加液体浓盐酸，方程式条件写「△」。: The reactants are solid MnO₂ and liquid concentrated HCl; the equation's condition is written "△".
不加热时产生速率 0.0 mL/min：装置再完整，也没有气体出来。: Without heating the rate is 0.0 mL/min: however complete the apparatus, no gas comes out.
加热用酒精灯垫石棉网，让烧瓶均匀受热，别局部暴沸。: Heat with a spirit lamp over gauze so the flask heats evenly without local bumping.
去掉加热：整条链一个气泡都不出，后面的除杂、收集全是空跑。: Skip heating and not a single bubble comes out; purification and collection downstream run empty.
方程式漏写「△」是最高频失分点，和「稀盐酸不反应」常一起考。: Leaving out "△" in the equation is the most common way to lose marks, often tested together with "dilute HCl does not react".
浓盐酸与 MnO₂ 的反应要加热才进行：不加热，滴多少浓盐酸都不产生 Cl₂。: Concentrated HCl and MnO₂ react only when heated: without heat, no amount of concentrated HCl produces Cl₂.
一直滴下去，为什么氯气会自己停下来？: If we keep adding acid, why does the chlorine stop on its own?
什么都不用动，看约一分钟：盐酸越来越稀，气泡越来越少，最后停住: Don't touch anything; watch for about a minute: the acid gets more dilute, bubbles grow fewer and finally stop
盐酸质量分数从 37 % 降到 20 %，产生速率从 30.0 mL/min 掉: HCl mass fraction falls from 37 % to 20 %, the rate falls from 30.0 mL/min to 0.0 mL/min, and the point on the curve slides to 20 % and reaches zero
浓盐酸 37 % → 20 % 后停止（稀盐酸与 MnO₂ 不反应）: Concentrated HCl stops at 37 % → 20 % (dilute HCl does not react with MnO₂)
实际要多称 MnO₂: Weigh out extra MnO₂ in practice
反应消耗 HCl，浓盐酸逐渐变稀，稀盐酸与 MnO₂ 不再反应。: The reaction uses up HCl, so the acid gradually becomes dilute, and dilute HCl no longer reacts with MnO₂.
所以 HCl 不能完全反应：教材第 7 题问「为什么实际称取的 MnO₂ 要适当: So the HCl cannot all react. Textbook question 7 asks "why weigh out somewhat more MnO₂ than the theoretical amount", and this is the answer.
按教材第 7 题算：4 瓶 100 mL 氯气理论上需要 MnO₂ 1.427: Following textbook question 7: 4 bottles of 100 mL chlorine theoretically need 1.427 g of MnO₂ (about 1.43 g).
去掉这一步的观察：会误以为「多加盐酸就多产气」，按 HCl 完全反应算产量，结果: Skip this observation and you may think "more acid means more gas", and calculate the yield as if all HCl reacted, getting too high a value.
「浓盐酸不能完全反应」与「MnO₂ 过量还是盐酸过量」是同一道题的两问。: "Concentrated HCl cannot fully react" and "is MnO₂ or HCl in excess" are two parts of the same question.
浓盐酸在反应中变稀，稀盐酸与 MnO₂ 不反应，气体自己就停了——这正是实际称取: Concentrated HCl becomes dilute during the reaction, and dilute HCl does not react with MnO₂, so the gas stops by itself; that is why somewhat more MnO₂ than the theoretical amount is weighed out.
第一瓶洗什么: What the first bottle washes out
挥发的 HCl 跟着氯气跑进集气瓶，会怎样？: Volatile HCl travels with the chlorine into the gas jar. What happens?
先把「饱和食盐水」这一段拆掉（错误操作），盯住集气瓶纯度和进气管口: First remove the "saturated brine" section (a mistake) and watch the gas jar purity and the inlet
Gas jar purity 99.4 % → 87.9 %, HCl impurity 0.5 % → 12.0 %; reconnect it and it recovers at once
长进短出 · 进气管口低于液面: Long in, short out · inlet below the liquid surface
除杂装置依据「杂质的性质」选：HCl 极易溶于水，用饱和食盐水洗掉它。: Choose purification by the impurity's properties: HCl is extremely soluble in water, so saturated brine washes it out.
不能用 NaOH、NaHCO₃、碱石灰除 HCl：它们会连 Cl₂ 一起吸收。: NaOH, NaHCO₃ or soda lime cannot remove HCl here: they would absorb the Cl₂ too.
洗气瓶必须长进短出：进气管口低于液面，气体才能被洗涤液充分接触。: A wash bottle must be long in, short out: with the inlet below the surface the gas fully contacts the washing liquid.
去掉这一段：集气瓶纯度掉到 87.9 %，瓶里混着 HCl，做性质实验会被白雾干: Remove this section and gas jar purity drops to 87.9 %; the jar contains HCl, and property tests are spoiled by white fumes.
「除 HCl 能不能用 NaOH 溶液」几乎年年出现，答案是能除 HCl 但会把: "Can NaOH solution remove the HCl?" comes up almost every year. Answer: it removes HCl but also eats the Cl₂.
浓盐酸易挥发，气流里带着 HCl；饱和食盐水吸收 HCl，同时抑制 Cl₂ 溶解: Concentrated HCl is volatile, so the gas stream carries HCl; saturated brine absorbs HCl while suppressing Cl₂ dissolving, so the first bottle washes out HCl.
为什么先除 HCl 再干燥，两个瓶子能对调吗？: Why remove HCl first and dry afterwards? Can the two bottles swap?
把「浓硫酸干燥」这一段拆掉（错误操作），看集气瓶内壁和两条布条: Remove the "concentrated sulfuric acid drying" section (a mistake) and watch the gas jar walls and the two cloth strips
纯度 99.4 % → 97.0 %，水汽 0.1 % → 2.5 %，集气瓶内: Purity 99.4 % → 97.0 %, water vapor 0.1 % → 2.5 %, the jar walls fog up; wet chlorine bleaches the colored strip while the dry strip is unchanged
顺序不能颠倒：先干燥再经食盐水，水汽又被带回来。: The order cannot be reversed: if you dry first and then pass through brine, water vapor comes back.
浓硫酸只除水汽，不与 Cl₂ 反应，所以放在除 HCl 之后。: Concentrated sulfuric acid only removes water vapor and does not react with Cl₂, so it goes after HCl removal.
干氯气不能漂白干燥布条：真正漂白的是 Cl₂ 与水生成的 HClO。: Dry chlorine cannot bleach a dry cloth strip: the real bleach is HClO formed from Cl₂ and water.
去掉这一段：水汽 2.5 %，布条褪色，会误判「Cl₂ 有漂白性」。: Remove this section: 2.5 % water vapor, the strip fades, and you may wrongly conclude "Cl₂ bleaches".
「干燥氯气无漂白性、湿润氯气有」是必考设问，配 p.51 第 3 题那样的装置图: "Dry chlorine does not bleach, moist chlorine does" is a must-test question, with an apparatus diagram like p.51 question 3.
干燥要放在除 HCl 之后；而且只有湿氯气（真正起作用的是它溶水生出的 HClO: Drying comes after HCl removal; and only wet chlorine (really the HClO it forms with water) fades a colored strip.
氯气比空气重还是轻？导管该插到哪儿？: Is chlorine heavier or lighter than air? Where should the tube go?
在 3D 里点一下集气瓶，看两根导管分别插到哪里: Click the gas jar in 3D and see where each of the two tubes goes
进气导管伸到瓶底、出气短管在瓶口；瓶里黄绿色从下往上积；氯气密度 3.214 g: The inlet tube reaches the bottom and the short outlet sits at the mouth; yellow-green fills the jar from the bottom up; chlorine's density 3.214 g/L is 2.486 times that of air, 1.293 g/L
向上排空气法 · 长进短出: Upward air displacement · long in, short out
密度判据：3.214 / 1.293 = 2.486 > 1，氯气比空气重，所以: Density test: 3.214 / 1.293 = 2.486 > 1, chlorine is heavier than air, so use upward air displacement (both densities at 0 ℃).
不能用排水法：25 ℃ 时 1 体积水溶解约 2 体积 Cl₂，还与水反应。: Cannot collect over water: at 25 ℃, 1 volume of water dissolves about 2 volumes of Cl₂, and it also reacts with water.
长进短出才能把瓶里的空气顶干净：短进长出只会在瓶口打转。: Only long in, short out pushes all the air out of the jar; short in, long out just swirls at the mouth.
去掉这一段（改成排水法）：氯气溶掉、又混进水汽，白制一场。: Replace this section with water displacement and the chlorine dissolves and picks up water vapor: all that work wasted.
「能不能用排水法收集氯气」与「进气导管长还是短」是成对出现的两道判断。: "Can chlorine be collected over water?" and "is the inlet tube long or short?" come as a pair of judgments.
密度比空气大的气体用向上排空气法：气体从瓶底进、把空气从瓶口顶出，所以进气长、出: Gases denser than air are collected by upward air displacement: gas enters at the bottom and pushes air out of the mouth, so the inlet is long and the outlet short; Cl₂ dissolves in and reacts with water, so it cannot be collected over water.
最后一个烧杯不接，会出什么事？: What goes wrong if the last beaker is not connected?
把「NaOH 尾气吸收」拆掉（错误操作），看导管口和顶栏状态: Remove the "NaOH exhaust absorption" (a mistake) and watch the tube end and the top bar status
排放从 0.0 升到 30.0 mL/min，风险条 0.00 → 1.00、顶: Emission rises from 0.0 to 30.0 mL/min, the risk bar goes 0.00 → 1.00 and the top bar turns to "alarm"; the tube lifts and a yellow-green cloud pours from the mouth
多余氯气必须吸收，不能排空: Excess chlorine must be absorbed, never vented
氯气有毒：吸入少量刺激鼻咽喉黏膜、引起咳嗽和胸部疼痛，吸入大量会中毒致死。: Chlorine is toxic: a little irritates the nose and throat, causing coughing and chest pain; a lot can poison and kill.
NaOH 吸收氯气生成 NaCl 与 NaClO，这也正是漂白液的制取原理。: NaOH absorbs chlorine to form NaCl and NaClO, the same principle used to make bleach solution.
不用澄清石灰水：Ca(OH)₂ 浓度太低，不能确保把氯气吸收完全。: Clear limewater is not used: Ca(OH)₂ is too dilute to be sure of absorbing all the chlorine.
去掉这一段：30.0 mL/min 全部排空，这样的实验在教室里根本不能做。: Remove this section and all 30.0 mL/min vents to the air; such an experiment could never be done in a classroom.
「尾气为什么用 NaOH 而不是澄清石灰水」是经典简答题。: "Why use NaOH rather than limewater for the exhaust?" is a classic short-answer question.
多余的 Cl₂ 必须用 NaOH 溶液吸收：Cl₂ + 2NaOH = NaCl: Excess Cl₂ must be absorbed by NaOH solution: Cl₂ + 2NaOH = NaCl + NaClO + H₂O; without the exhaust trap, chlorine goes straight into the classroom.
把氯气溶进水里，水里到底有几种东西？: Dissolve chlorine in water. How many kinds of things are in the water?
把光照时间从 0 s 推到 150 s，盯住 pH、c(Cl⁻) 和示意放大里的: Push the light exposure time from 0 s to 150 s, watching the pH, c(Cl⁻) and the particles in the magnified view
pH 2.10 → 1.62、c(Cl⁻) 200 → 850 mg/L、氧气体: pH 2.10 → 1.62, c(Cl⁻) 200 → 850 mg/L, oxygen volume fraction 20.0 % → 21.1 %; in the magnified view HClO keeps decomposing and releasing O₂, and the tube's yellow-green fades
次氯酸见光分解，氯水久置会失效: Hypochlorous acid decomposes in light, so chlorine water loses its effect on standing
氯水里有 Cl₂、H₂O、HClO，以及 H⁺、Cl⁻、ClO⁻；漂白消毒的是: Chlorine water contains Cl₂, H₂O and HClO, plus H⁺, Cl⁻ and ClO⁻; the bleaching and disinfecting agent is HClO, not Cl₂.
次氯酸见光分解：2HClO —光照→ 2HCl + O₂↑。: Hypochlorous acid decomposes in light: 2HClO —light→ 2HCl + O₂↑.
所以光照后 pH 下降、c(Cl⁻) 上升、氧气体积分数上升，三个方向都能测出来: So after light exposure the pH falls, c(Cl⁻) rises and the oxygen fraction rises: all three directions can be measured.
去掉这一步：只知道「氯水能漂白」，解释不了久置失效，也说不清 AgNO₃ 检验的: Skip this step and you only know "chlorine water bleaches", without explaining why it goes off on standing or where the white AgNO₃ precipitate comes from.
教材图 2-16 的三个量（pH、c(Cl⁻)、φ(O₂)）变化方向，是新课标情: The directions of change of the three quantities in textbook Fig. 2-16 (pH, c(Cl⁻), φ(O₂)) are the prototype for new-curriculum context questions.
氯水里有 Cl₂、H₂O、HClO 和 H⁺、Cl⁻、ClO⁻；次氯酸见光分解出: Chlorine water contains Cl₂, H₂O, HClO and H⁺, Cl⁻, ClO⁻; hypochlorous acid decomposes in light into O₂ and HCl, so the pH falls, c(Cl⁻) rises and oxygen increases, and chlorine water left standing loses its effect.
给你一套装置，能不能一次收满一瓶又纯又安全的氯气？: Given the apparatus, can you fill one bottle with chlorine that is pure and safe in a single run?
纯度 ≥ 99.0 %、集气瓶收够 95 mL、尾气接好、风险在警戒线下，保持: Purity ≥ 99.0 %, at least 95 mL collected, exhaust connected and risk below the warning line, held for 12 s; partway through, the drip rate will be set to 0
达标横幅「一瓶纯净的氯气」；第 6 秒滴加速率被拨到 0，要重新拨回 40 滴/: Pass banner "A bottle of pure chlorine"; at 6 s the drip rate is set to 0, and you must set it back to 40 drops/min to continue collecting
关掉尾气：风险立刻满格 1.00，顶栏转报警。: Exhaust off: risk jumps to the full 1.00 and the top bar turns to alarm.
没有新内容：前八步的条件同时满足，就是通过。: Nothing new: meeting the conditions of the first eight steps at once is a pass.
满分结构：装置顺序 + 每段作用 + 纯度判据，三条一起写。: Full-mark structure: apparatus order + job of each section + purity criterion, written together.
考核没有新结论：五段各就位、加热、滴加速率合适，才收得到 ≥ 99.0 % 的氯: The check has no new conclusion: only with all five sections in place, heating on and the right drip rate can you collect ≥ 99.0 % chlorine.
未达标：滴加归零: Not met: drip rate at zero
未达标：浓盐酸已变稀: Not met: HCl has become dilute
Class goal: purity ≥ 99.0 %, collected ≥ 95 mL, exhaust connected, risk < 0.4, held for 12 s
实验室制氯气的化学方程式，正确的是: The correct equation for preparing chlorine in the lab is
教材 p.48：MnO₂ + 4HCl(浓) —△→ MnCl₂ + Cl₂↑: Textbook p.48: MnO₂ + 4HCl(conc.) —△→ MnCl₂ + Cl₂↑ + 2H₂O. Neither "△" nor "conc." may be omitted; balance by electrons gained and lost, 1 : 2.
制得的氯气总比按 HCl 完全反应算出的理论量少，主要原因是: The chlorine obtained is always less than the theoretical amount calculated as if all HCl reacted, mainly because
浓盐酸在反应中变稀，稀盐酸与 MnO₂ 不反应: Concentrated HCl becomes dilute during the reaction, and dilute HCl does not react with MnO₂
收集时氯气比空气重: Chlorine is heavier than air during collection
教材 p.52 第 7(2)：随反应进行浓盐酸变稀，稀盐酸与 MnO₂ 不再反应: Textbook p.52 question 7(2): as the reaction proceeds the concentrated HCl becomes dilute and no longer reacts with MnO₂, so extra MnO₂ is weighed out in practice.
除去氯气中混有的少量 HCl，应选用的试剂是: To remove a little HCl mixed in chlorine, the reagent to use is
HCl 极易溶于水，饱和食盐水还能抑制 Cl₂ 溶解；其余三种都会把 Cl₂ 一: HCl is extremely soluble in water, and saturated brine also suppresses Cl₂ dissolving; the other three would absorb the Cl₂ as well.
关于除杂与干燥的顺序，正确的是: The correct order of purification and drying is
先用浓硫酸干燥，再经饱和食盐水除 HCl: Dry with concentrated sulfuric acid first, then remove HCl with saturated brine
先除 HCl，再用浓硫酸干燥: Remove HCl first, then dry with concentrated sulfuric acid
两瓶可以对调，效果一样: The two bottles can swap with the same effect
只要接了浓硫酸就不必除 HCl: Once concentrated sulfuric acid is connected, HCl need not be removed
先干燥再经食盐水洗气，水汽又被带回来；所以顺序是除杂 → 干燥。: If you dry first and then wash through brine, water vapor comes back; so the order is purification → drying.
关于氯气的收集，正确的是: Which statement about collecting chlorine is correct?
可用排水法收集: It can be collected over water
用向上排空气法，进气导管伸到瓶底: Use upward air displacement with the inlet tube reaching the bottom of the jar
集气瓶口朝下最稳妥: Holding the jar mouth down is safest
0 ℃ 时氯气密度 3.214 g/L，约为同温空气 1.293 g/L 的 2: At 0 ℃ chlorine's density is 3.214 g/L, about 2.486 times that of air at the same temperature (1.293 g/L); chlorine also dissolves in and reacts with water, so use upward air displacement, long in and short out.
多余氯气的处理，正确的是: The correct treatment of excess chlorine is
直接排入空气: Vent it directly to the air
Cl₂ + 2NaOH = NaCl + NaClO + H₂O；澄清石灰水浓度: Cl₂ + 2NaOH = NaCl + NaClO + H₂O; clear limewater is too dilute to absorb it all, and water absorbs little and incompletely.
氯水光照后，下列变化正确的是: After chlorine water is exposed to light, the correct change is
pH 下降、c(Cl⁻) 上升、氧气增多: pH falls, c(Cl⁻) rises, oxygen increases
2HClO —光照→ 2HCl + O₂↑：生成强酸 HCl，所以 pH 下降、: 2HClO —light→ 2HCl + O₂↑: the strong acid HCl forms, so the pH falls and c(Cl⁻) rises, while oxygen is released (textbook Fig. 2-16).
能说明「干燥氯气没有漂白性」的实验现象是: The observation that shows "dry chlorine does not bleach" is
干燥有色布条不褪色: A dry colored strip does not fade
氯水使石蕊先变红后褪色: Chlorine water turns litmus red, then bleaches it
氯气使湿润淀粉碘化钾试纸变蓝: Chlorine turns moist starch–potassium iodide paper blue
干燥氯气接触干燥布条不褪色，说明起漂白作用的是氯气与水反应生成的 HClO（教材: Dry chlorine in contact with a dry strip does not fade it, showing that the bleaching agent is the HClO formed when chlorine reacts with water (textbook p.46 Experiment 2-8, p.51 question 3).
已加热：MnO₂ 与浓盐酸开始反应，产生氯气: Heated: MnO₂ starts reacting with concentrated HCl, producing chlorine
已停止加热：不再产生氯气: Heating stopped: no more chlorine produced
拆掉饱和食盐水：HCl 混进气流，集气瓶纯度掉到 87.9 %: Brine removed: HCl enters the gas stream and gas jar purity drops to 87.9 %
拆掉浓硫酸：湿氯气进瓶，水汽 2.5 %，布条褪色: Sulfuric acid removed: wet chlorine enters the jar, 2.5 % water vapor, the strip fades
拆掉尾气吸收：氯气正在排空，有毒，风险满格: Exhaust absorption removed: toxic chlorine is venting, risk at maximum
异常：滴加速率被拨到 0——氯气停了，先把它拨回 40 滴/min: Fault: the drip rate was set to 0, so chlorine has stopped; set it back to 40 drops/min first
已回到参考工况：加热、40 滴/min、除杂干燥与尾气全接好: Back to reference conditions: heated, 40 drops/min, purification, drying and exhaust all connected
达标：一瓶纯净的氯气: Passed: a bottle of pure chlorine
开 / 停（暂停与继续装置运行）: Start / stop (pause and resume the apparatus)
本课目标：把五段装置和加热、滴加速率调到位，收满一瓶 ≥ 99.0 % 的氯气并: Lesson goal: set up the five sections, heating and drip rate, then fill a bottle with ≥ 99.0 % chlorine and hold for 12 s; partway through the drip rate will be set to 0, and you must spot it and set it back.
